RumorFact.Text: I have learnt the the local sun is unstable, and will explode and destroy the planet about 22 minutes into the loop.

ExploreFact.Text: I am in orbit of a star. Much like my home sun, I suspect it does not have long until it goes supernova and destroys this system.

AltText.Text: The local sun is unstable, and will explode and destroy the planet about 22 minutes into the loop.

ExploreFact.Text: I attempted to explore the sun to investigate its instability issues. I have learnt that the sun is very hot. Very very hot. Bad idea.

RumorFact.Text: There is a space probe monitoring the sun. This must be how they found out the sun was unstable and going to destroy their planet.

ExploreFact.Text: Nope, this star doesn't have any mysterious cloaked objects. Investigating this probe was a waste of time, how disapointing.
